Please join us for AAUC's next town hall meeting, “In Challenging Times, Our Voices Matter,” on Thursday, March 19th, at 1 PM Eastern. Register here (https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/pEMGKU_qQMCxjFNlwkatDw?utm_source=AAUC_2026&utm_campaign=68addf2152-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_01_13_08_13_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f8a133a269-646753843#/registration) .

At moments like this, it becomes even more important to remember who we are as a community and the role we have played and continue to play in shaping America’s values, resilience, and moral leadership.
